name: MS Dynamics
description: Suite of business apps for managing finance, sales, customer service, and operations.
fun_fact: First ERP/CRM suite with a unified business and customer platform.

name: Salesforce
description: Cloud-based CRM platform for managing sales, service, marketing, and commerce.
fun_fact: Salesforce has a mascot bear named Astro.

name: Slack
description: Business messaging and collaboration tool for real-time communication and workflow automation.
competitors: Microsoft Teams, Google Chat, Zoom, Webex
fun_fact: Slack was originally an internal tool for a failed video game.

name: Adobe Photoshop
description: Industry-standard software for editing and creating graphics, photos, and artwork.
competitors: Corel PaintShop, GIMP, Affinity Photo, Pixelmator
fun_fact: The name Photoshop is now used as a verb.

name: SAP S/4HANA
description: Next-generation ERP suite that integrates business processes using real-time analytics.
competitors: Oracle NetSuite, MS Dynamics, Infor, Epicor
fun_fact: SAP stands for Systems, Applications and Products.

name: QuickBooks
description: Widely used accounting and bookkeeping software for small and medium businesses.

name: Figma
description: Cloud-based design tool for UI/UX, prototyping, and collaboration in real time.
fun_fact: Figma runs entirely in your web browser.

name: Oracle NetSuite
description: Comprehensive cloud ERP platform for financials, CRM, ecommerce, and supply chain.
fun_fact: NetSuite was acquired by Oracle in 2016 for $9.3 billion.

name: AutoCAD
description: Computer-aided design software for drafting and modeling in architecture, engineering, and construction.
fun_fact: AutoCAD was launched in 1982 and is still industry standard.

name: Zoom
description: Cloud platform for video meetings, webinars, chat, and virtual collaboration.
competitors: Microsoft Teams, Webex, Google Meet, GoToMeeting
fun_fact: Zoom's user base soared during the COVID-19 pandemic.
